goal: Once overnight is released, its users, a person or an AI, get their queued Claude Code tasks done in the hours nobody answers, through the usage limit, instead of spending the daytime limit on them: in the evening they queue tasks to start at a set time, and in the morning they read which tasks finished and which were given up, and merge the results from their main session.

deliverable.name: overnight's developers know whom overnight serves, and what its users do with it once it holds

decisions.decided: a person, or an AI such as another plugin's orchestrator, who has Claude Code tasks to run while nobody answers
the user sets how many tasks run at once
